mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FIN_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = #{codeType}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FIN_CODE (CODE_TYPE, CODE, CODE_NAME, PARENT_CODE, CODE_LEVEL, SORT_NO) VALUES (#{codeType}, #{code}, #{codeName}, #{parentCode}, #{codeLevel}, #{sortNo})
mapper.select: SELECT CODE_TYPE, CODE, CODE_NAME, PARENT_CODE, CODE_LEVEL, SORT_NO FROM FIN_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = #{codeType} ORDER BY SORT_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FIN_PROGRAM (PROG_ID, FISCAL_YEAR, PROG_LEVEL, PARENT_ID, PROG_TYPE, FUNC_CODE, PROG_NAME, DEPT_NAME, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, DELETED_YN) VALUES (#{progId}, #{fiscalYear}, #{progLevel}, #{parentId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{progType}, #{funcCode}, #{progName}, #{deptName}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, 'N')
mapper.sql: P.PROG_ID, P.FISCAL_YEAR, P.PROG_LEVEL, P.PARENT_ID, P.PROG_TYPE, P.FUNC_CODE, P.PROG_NAME, P.DEPT_NAME, P.CREATED_BY, P.CREATED_AT, (SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM FIN_CODE C WHERE C.CODE_TYPE = 'FUNC' AND C.CODE = P.FUNC_CODE) AS FUNC_NAME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM FIN_PROGRAM P WHERE P.FISCAL_YEAR = #{year} AND P.DELETED_YN = 'N' ORDER BY P.PROG_ID
SELECT FROM FIN_PROGRAM P WHERE P.PROG_ID = #{progId} AND P.DELETED_YN = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FIN_PROGRAM WHERE PARENT_ID = #{progId} AND DELETED_YN = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FIN_BUDGET WHERE DETAIL_ID = #{progId} AND DELETED_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE FIN_PROGRAM SET DELETED_YN = 'Y' WHERE PROG_ID = #{progId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FIN_BUDGET (BUDGET_ID, KIND, FISCAL_YEAR, DETAIL_ID, CODE, AMOUNT, BASIS, STATUS, DEPT_NAME, REQUESTER_ID, REQUESTER_NAME, REQUESTED_AT, CREATED_AT, DELETED_YN) VALUES (#{budgetId}, #{kind}, #{fiscalYear}, #{detailId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{code}, #{amount}, #{basis}, #{status}, #{deptName}, #{requesterId}, #{requesterName}, #{requestedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{createdAt}, 'N')
mapper.update: UPDATE FIN_BUDGET SET DETAIL_ID = #{detailId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, CODE = #{code}, AMOUNT = #{amount}, BASIS = #{basis}, STATUS = #{status}, REQUESTER_ID = #{requesterId}, REQUESTER_NAME = #{requesterName}, REQUESTED_AT = #{requestedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE BUDGET_ID = #{budgetId} AND STATUS IN ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED') AND DELETED_YN = 'N'
mapper.sql: B.BUDGET_ID, B.KIND, B.FISCAL_YEAR, B.DETAIL_ID, B.CODE, B.AMOUNT, B.BASIS, B.STATUS, B.DEPT_NAME, B.REQUESTER_ID, B.REQUESTER_NAME, B.REQUESTED_AT, B.REVIEWER_ID, B.REVIEWER_NAME, B.REVIEWED_AT, B.REVIEW_NOTE, B.CREATED_AT, B.UPDATED_AT, C.CODE_NAME, D.PROG_NAME AS DETAIL_NAME, U.PROG_NAME AS UNIT_NAME, PL.PROG_NAME AS POLICY_NAME, PL.PROG_TYPE AS POLICY_TYPE, PL.FUNC_CODE, (SELECT NVL(SUM(T.AMOUNT), 0) FROM FIN_TXN T WHERE T.BUDGET_ID = B.BUDGET_ID AND T.CANCELLED_YN = 'N') AS USED

FROM FIN_BUDGET B LEFT JOIN FIN_CODE C ON C.CODE_TYPE = CASE WHEN B.KIND = 'EXP' THEN 'ITEM' ELSE 'REV' END AND C.CODE = B.CODE LEFT JOIN FIN_PROGRAM D ON D.PROG_ID = B.DETAIL_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PROGRAM U ON U.PROG_ID = D.PARENT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PROGRAM PL ON PL.PROG_ID = U.PARENT_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE FIN_BUDGET SET DELETED_YN = 'Y' WHERE BUDGET_ID = #{budgetId} AND STATUS IN ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED') AND DELETED_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT BUDGET_ID, KIND, FISCAL_YEAR, CODE, AMOUNT, STATUS, DEPT_NAME FROM FIN_BUDGET WHERE BUDGET_ID = #{budgetId} AND DELETED_YN = 'N' FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FIN_TXN (TXN_ID, KIND, FISCAL_YEAR, BUDGET_ID, CODE, TXN_DATE, AMOUNT, PARTY, DESCRIPTION, DEPT_NAME, CREATED_BY, CREATED_NAME, CREATED_AT, CANCELLED_YN) VALUES (#{txnId}, #{kind}, #{fiscalYear}, #{budgetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{code}, #{txnDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{amount}, #{party}, #{description}, #{deptName}, #{createdBy}, #{createdName}, #{createdAt}, 'N')
mapper.sql: T.TXN_ID, T.KIND, T.FISCAL_YEAR, T.BUDGET_ID, T.CODE, T.TXN_DATE, T.AMOUNT, T.PARTY, T.DESCRIPTION, T.DEPT_NAME, T.CREATED_BY, T.CREATED_NAME, T.CREATED_AT, T.CANCELLED_YN, T.CANCELLED_BY, T.CANCELLED_AT, (SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM FIN_CODE C WHERE C.CODE_TYPE = CASE WHEN T.KIND = 'EXP' THEN 'ITEM' ELSE 'REV' END AND C.CODE = T.CODE) AS CODE_NAME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM FIN_TXN T WHERE T.TXN_ID = #{txnId}
SELECT FROM FIN_TXN T WHERE T.BUDGET_ID = #{budgetId} ORDER BY T.TXN_DATE DESC, T.TXN_ID DESC
SELECT NVL(SUM(AMOUNT), 0) FROM FIN_TXN WHERE BUDGET_ID = #{budgetId} AND CANCELLED_YN = 'N'
SELECT T.CODE, SUM(T.AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT FROM FIN_TXN T WHERE T.KIND = 'REV' AND T.FISCAL_YEAR = #{year} AND T.CANCELLED_YN = 'N' GROUP BY T.CODE
mapper.update: UPDATE FIN_TXN SET CANCELLED_YN = 'Y', CANCELLED_BY = #{by}, CANCELLED_AT = #{at} WHERE TXN_ID = #{txnId} AND CANCELLED_YN = 'N'
